name: PKU-GoodsAD: Supermarket Goods Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: Comprehensive visual anomaly detection and segmentation benchmark for retail product quality inspection, containing 6,124 high-resolution images (3000x3000 resolution) spanning 484 different supermarket products in six categories (drink bottles, drink cans, food bottles, food boxes, food packages, and cigarette boxes). Developed by Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School, it provides normal training images and defective test images featuring deformations, surface damage, and opened packaging with pixel-precise ground truth masks.
